docs.title: django-food-recipes
docs.text:
Core Django recipe models: diets, cooking methods, types, categories, recipes, steps, and ingredient quantities. Depends on django-ingredients (and thus django-allergens).

Recipe content is not seeded by this package — use admin or a consumer import. Taxonomy rows are created by the site.

docs.title: Install
docs.text:
pip install django-food-recipes

Until sibling packages are on PyPI, CI/install may resolve django-ingredients from GitHub (see pyproject.toml).

INSTALLED_APPS = [
    "modeltranslation",
    # ...
    "easy_thumbnails",
    "filer",
    "mptt",
    "polymorphic",
    "allergens",
    "ingredients",
    "recipes",
]

python manage.py migrate

docs.title: Usage
docs.text:
from recipes.models import Recipe

recipe = Recipe.objects.get(slug="test-pasta")
print(recipe.allergen_slugs())

Translated URL prefixes (via gettext + i18n_patterns):

English Italian diets/ diete/ cooking/ tipi-cottura/ types/ piatto/ categories/ categorie/ recipes/ ricette/
